dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Various Map Series, 1965 to 2006, is a bilingual map that how status of 1:250 000 mapping as of 1994. The base map has the grid of 1:250 000 sheet outlines, and each square is coloured in one of four colours to indicate the latest revision status of each of map. All parts of Canada are mapped at this scale. The map was produced by the Topographic Mapping group of Natural Resources Canada, although no authorship is given.
